title: Codex v2 Result Carrier Receipt (issue #508)
description: Closure receipt for the durable result-carrier / executor-provenance / strict-worker-result lane. codex-v2-local-handoff-queue.json names 'agentic-tech-lead/codex-v2-result-carrier/v1' as the receipt id for its only item, and that id previously declared no contract file at all: the committed receipt was hand-authored prose whose verdict, control results and lane states no validator could read (#607). This schema is shape and vocabulary only. A schema-valid document is a claim about deterministic mechanics; it is never live-run acceptance, never merge, and never promotion of the #464 live lane -- that lane's PASS is emitted under agentic-tech-lead/codex-v2-live-run/v1, not here.

subject.description: The exact implementation subject this receipt binds. The receipt file itself lands later; the bound subject is the commit whose trees were carried, not the commit that carries the paperwork.

owning_files.description: Repository-relative path -> SHA-256 of the file content the receipt was written against, so a later edit to an owning file is detectable rather than silently inherited.

required_outcomes.description: One named outcome per required capability. Free-form supporting keys are admitted, but each outcome must carry a machine-readable state so a prose paragraph cannot stand in for a verdict.

controls.description: Planted controls. A control that did not turn red is not a control, so the admissible results are RED_FOR_REASON and the honest not-run states.

self_demo.description: One real end-to-end round trip outside the test suite, if one was performed.

live_codex_execution.description: A live Codex turn cannot be admitted by this document class. Its PASS is carried by agentic-tech-lead/codex-v2-live-run/v1 against a named queue subject; recording it here would let deterministic carrier mechanics launder themselves into a live run.

merge.description: Merge is repository authority, never an agent verdict.

residual_gaps.description: Required, because an omitted residual list is itself a claim that nothing is missing. An empty array says exactly that, on the record.

then.description: A PASS verdict must name the outcomes it passed and the round trip it performed. Without both, the verdict is prose.
